reason: The quote is verbatim (NodeSystem.java:825-836) and NodeSystem really has no removePotionEffect; the only removals are arena-exit paths (PlayerGoodsManager.java:209-211 via ArenaInstance.removePlayer:464, and MultiArenaManager.applyLobbyState:1081-1083), so nothing leaks across sessions. The residual is bounded by the configured duration, not indefinite: defaults are buff-refresh-ticks: 60 and buff-duration-ticks: 100 (game-settings.yml:140/144; GameConfig.java:123/127), and applyAllBuffs only calls applyBuffsToPlayer when activeNodeCount > 0 (NodeSystem.java:788-791), so after the last application a player who leaves the radius or loses the node keeps the effect for at most 100 ticks (~5 s), and the amplifier downgrade lags by at most one duration. Paper 1.21.4's MobEffectInstance.update (checked in the shipped versions/1.21.4/paper-1.21.4.jar bytecode) never lets a weaker amplifier overwrite a stronger one and stores a weaker-but-longer effect as hiddenEffect until the stronger expires, which is directionally as claimed but bounded, not a ratchet. Two impact statements are false: buff-duration-ticks is not GUI-exposed (NodeSettingsMenu.java:45-48 exposes only buff-radius; CHANGELOG.md:248 lists duration/refresh/stack-cap among keys deliberately excluded), and duration > refresh does not create a 'permanent free buff' - it is exactly the hysteresis that prevents gaps while in range, since leaving the radius stops all application. With duration 100 vs refresh 60 this is a 5-second buff tail plus a delayed downgrade, i.e. a low-severity polish issue, not medium.
counter_evidence:
NodeSystem.java:789-791 — `if (activeNodeCount > 0) {` / `applyBuffsToPlayer(player, activeNodeCount);` / `}` (no application once the player is out of range, so the effect cannot be sustained)
game-settings.yml:140 `buff-refresh-ticks: 60` and :144 `buff-duration-ticks: 100` (GameConfig.java:123/127 same defaults) — residual is capped at 100 ticks, not indefinite
NodeSettingsMenu.java:45-48 — `addAdjustableItem(14, Material.ENDER_EYE, lang.getFor(admin, "config.menu.nodes.buff-radius"), cfg.getNodeBuffRadius(), 3, 60, 2, ... )` (only radius is editable in the config GUI; no duration/refresh/stack-cap control)
PlayerGoodsManager.java:209-211 — `for (PotionEffect effect : new ArrayList<>(player.getActivePotionEffects())) { player.removePotionEffect(effect.getType()); }` (arena exit clears node buffs)
CHANGELOG.md:248 — `nodes.base-health`/`buff-radius`/`self-destruct-multiplier`/... are the GUI entries; `buff-duration-ticks`/`buff-refresh-ticks`/`buff-stack-cap` are not among them
